svg.data-forwarding-tables: up to 48K MPLS labels, 324K LPM, up to 128K ACL
svg.data-input-ac: 100-240 VAC auto-ranging, 47-63 Hz (datasheet); 90-264 VAC, 50-60 Hz, 3.4-7.1 A (guide)
svg.data-fans: 3+1 redundant hot-swap fans, front-to-back or back-to-front
svg.data-cpu: Intel Atom C x86 (up to 8 core) on a COM-Express module
svg.data-bmc: BMC with IPMI 2.0, NC-SI shared management port, Serial over LAN
svg.data-breakout: each QSFP28 port breaks out to 4x25G or 4x10G; system maximums 128 x 10/25GbE or 64 x 50GbE (datasheet)
svg.data-transceiver-power: QSFP28 up to 4.5 W / 5.5 W (partial) power; DAC to 5 m passive
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: guide Table 1: 100GBASE-SR4 over OM3/OM4 parallel multimode, 100GBASE-LR4 (10 km) over single-mode, 100GBASE-CR4 copper DAC at 1 m 30AWG, 3 m 28AWG and 5 m 26AWG; 4x25G breakout by cable without a reboot
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: guide Table 1 (as printed): 10GBASE-SR over OM3/OM4, 10GBASE-LR (10 km) single-mode, 10G copper DAC at 1, 3, 5 and 7 m; the table writes the SFP+ modules as SR4/LR4/CR4, which is the QSFP row's wording copied
